newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: OPTIONS -- Rollovers dominate Dutch options trade.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS -- Rollovers dominate Dutch options trade.

text.p: Trades among market makers and rollovers from the October series to later months dominated trade on the European Options Exchange (EOE) on Friday.

"Volumes looked quite healthy, especially after the U.S. payrolls data, but most of the business was done between market makers. Other operators were mainly rolling over their October contracts," said one dealer.
Financial group ING accounted for 17.5 percent of all trades, only slightly less than the 19.3 percent slice of the day's action claimed by options on the AEX share index.
